0.reason: an empty --cores value means the caller supplied no count, and the per-rung default is the intended result

findings.text: non-blocking: an explicit empty --cores value falls through rung_cores' non-empty test and is silently replaced by the per-rung default, so a caller passing --cores "$N" with N unset gets a completed submission at 4 or 7 cores instead of a refusal, where the previous single default made the same slip harmless.
